correctness.rationale: The two-round EF game equivalence equals equality of one-point five-bit character sets. A Duplicator strategy proves that per-class red/blue counts capped at two and shape multiplicity capped at two preserves rank-two theory for every finite structure. The 6560 nonempty canonical profiles are exhaustive. Exact closed-form bit computations and independent elementwise enumeration induce identical partitions; the complete distribution sums to 207 and has maximal minimum size 13. Two 13-point witnesses have local-character lower-bound arguments.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the minimal nontrivial unary expansion of equivalence-partition structures. The precise 207 theory count, canonical invariant and sharp optimal 13-point representative bound are useful as finite-model rank and small-model benchmarks; the extremal obstruction uses forbidden as well as demanded within-class colour profiles, rather than an arbitrary computational slice.
